description_en: Searches for addresses based on criteria such as address name, remarks, referenced health check template, or address ID
description_zh: 按照地址名称、备注信息、地址引用的探测模板或地址DI等信息搜索地址列表
name: SearchCloudGtmAddresses

parameters.help_en:
The language of the return value. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.

en-US: English. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh-CN：中文。

en-US（默认值）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: The name of the address. This name is used for easy identification
parameters.help_zh: 地址名称，一般为方便用户区分的名称
parameters.name: names

parameters.help_en:
The search logic for querying by address name. This parameter is required when you query by address name.

and: The query returns results that match all the specified keywords.

or: The query returns results that match some or all of the specified keywords
parameters.help_zh:
按地址名称查询时的搜索逻辑（选择地址名称查询时必选参数）：

and：展示输入的搜索条件全部命中的查询结果。

or：展示输入的搜索条件部分或全部命中的查询结果
parameters.name: name_search_condition

parameters.help_en:
Performs an exact search by the availability status of the address.

available: The address is available.

unavailable: The address is unavailable
parameters.help_zh:
按照地址可用状态条件精确搜索：

available：可用

unavailable：不可用
parameters.name: available_status

parameters.help_en:
Performs an exact search by the address type.

IPv4

IPv6

domain
parameters.help_zh:
按照地址类型条件精确搜索：

IPv4

IPv6

domain
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: Performs an exact search by endpoint. IP addresses and domain names are supported
parameters.help_zh: 按照服务地址条件精确查询，支持IP地址或者域名
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en: The name of the health check template
parameters.name: monitor_template_name

parameters.help_en:
Performs an exact search by the status of the address.

enable: The address is enabled.

disable: The address is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
按照地址启用状态进行精确查询：

enable：启用状态

disable：禁用状态
parameters.name: enable_status

parameters.help_en:
Performs an exact search by the health status of the address.

ok: All health check tasks for the referenced health check template are normal.

ok_alert: Some health check tasks for the referenced health check template are abnormal, but the address is still considered normal.

ok_no_monitor: The address does not reference any health check templates.

exceptional: Some or all health check tasks for the referenced health check template are abnormal, and the address is considered abnormal
parameters.help_zh:
按照地址健康状态进行精确查询：

ok：地址引用的健康探测模板探测任务全部正常。

ok_alert：地址引用的健康探测模板探测任务部分异常，地址判定为正常状态。

ok_no_monitor：地址没有引用任何健康探测模板。

exceptional：地址引用的健康探测模板探测任务部分或全部异常，但地址判定为异常状态
parameters.name: health_status

parameters.help_en:
The search logic for querying by address remarks. This parameter is required when you query by address remarks.

and: The query returns results that match all the specified keywords.

or: The query returns results that match some or all of the specified keywords
parameters.help_zh:
按地址备注查询时的搜索逻辑（选择地址备注查询时必选参数）：

and：展示输入的搜索条件全部命中的查询结果。

or：展示输入的搜索条件部分或全部命中的查询结果
parameters.name: remark_search_condition

parameters.help_en: The current page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the address. The address ID is a unique identifier
parameters.name: address_id
